mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ws_mcp_operation (id, operation_type, tenant_id, project_id, workspace_id, creator_id, status, total, created_count, success_count, failed_count, created_date, deadline_date) VALUES (#{id}, #{operationType}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{workspaceId}, #{creatorId}, #{status}, #{total}, #{createdCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{createdDate}, #{deadlineDate})

INSERT INTO ws_mcp_operation_item (operation_id, item_index, service_id, original_name, actual_name, status, refresh_status, source_snapshot, error_code, safe_reason, started_date) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{itemIndex}, #{serviceId}, #{originalName}, #{actualName}, #{status}, #{refreshStatus}, #{sourceSnapshot}, #{errorCode}, #{safeReason}, #{startedDate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ws_mcp_operation_item WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} ORDER BY item_index
mapper.update: UPDATE ws_mcp_operation SET status = #{status}, created_count = #{createdCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, finished_date = #{finishedDate} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE ws_mcp_operation SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE ws_mcp_operation_item SET service_id = #{serviceId}, actual_name = #{actualName}, status = #{status}, refresh_status = #{refreshStatus}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_code = #{errorCode}, safe_reason = #{safeReason}, finished_date = #{finishedDate} WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND item_index = #{itemIndex}
